summary.headline: The suspected DATA_DRIVEN_BLOCKER (gosMaterialVariation) is NOT data-driven: it is a fixed static combinations[] bitmask over 2 flags {ALPHA_TEST, IS_OVERLAY} x 6 base shaders (gameos_graphics.cpp:4849-4868). No define is sourced from material/config data. The variant space is finite and enumerable; proceed to PIPELINE-KEY-SCHEMA-1.
summary.overturns: pipeline-state-contract-recon-1.md assumed the gosMaterialVariation define loop was open-ended/non-enumerable. Re-examination (verified at gameos_graphics.cpp:399-411,4849-4868) shows it is a 2-flag static array. The earlier string-grep missed it because the macro name comes from the g_shader_flags[] array var, emitted as '#define <var> = 1'.

injection_mechanism.primary: glsl_shader::makeShader (GameOS/gameos/utils/shader_builder.cpp:446) glues prefix as a separate glShaderSource string before file source; no #version in .vert/.frag files. makeProgram2 passes same prefix to all stages; prefix_ cached + reused verbatim on reload().
injection_mechanism.material_path: gosMaterialVariationHelper::getMaterialVariation (gameos_graphics.cpp:346-396) builds prefix from a fixed defines vector + runtime-appended gates; also emits unique_name_suffix_ (an informal variant key already present).
injection_mechanism.compute_path: parallel hand-rolled std::vector<const char*> srcStrs in gpu_cull_compute.cpp / gpu_driven_common.cpp / gos_cardcloud_sim.cpp / gos_particle_bridge.cpp (not makeShader).

classes.OFFLINE_VARIANT: must become part of the shader-variant key
classes.UNIFORM_OR_MATERIAL_FIELD: should not be a compile variant long-term
classes.DEAD_OR_STALE: no live C++/shader consumer, or only a stale comment / always-false branch
classes.DATA_DRIVEN_BLOCKER: comes from arbitrary material data; not enumerable yet

macros.name: ALPHA_TEST
macros.note: array-driven inject (name from g_shader_flags), NOT a literal '#define ALPHA_TEST'; frag discard path. Also appears in legacy fixed-function .frag guards.

macros.name: MRT_ENABLED
macros.note: gates GBuffer1 output decl = render-target layout; runtime: FBO has attachment 1. Most-tested macro (~30 sites).

macros.name: MC2_SHADOW_CSM
macros.note: switches calcDynamicShadow to sampler2DArrayShadow + mat4[N] variant.

macros.name: MC2_SHADOW_CSM_MAX
macros.note: pure numeric cascade-count / array bound; ideal Vk spec-const.

macros.name: MC2_OBJECT_ID_BUFFER
macros.note: adds object-ID frag output (loc=2) = RT layout. In reflect.py KNOWN_VARIANT_MACROS.

macros.name: MC2_USE_VIEW_UNIFORMS
macros.note: compiles in UBO block binding=3 (descriptor-layout-affecting). reflect.py covers mech.{vert,frag} only; static_prop combo NOT compiled.

macros.name: MC2_COALESCE
macros.note: selects multi-draw/draw-param codepath. In reflect.py KNOWN_VARIANT_MACROS.

macros.name: MC2_STATICPROP_PBR_SLOTS
macros.note: gates extra ORM sampler bindings. Covered by NEITHER reflect.py NOR matrix anchors — reflection gap.

macros.name: GPU_CULL_C2_READBACK
macros.note: adds readback-SSBO write path to cull compute.

macros.name: READBACK_SSBO_BINDING
macros.note: numeric binding index; used as layout(binding=N) literal substitution, not a guard. In Vk = fixed descriptor-layout binding, not a true variant.

macros.name: ENABLE_VERTEX_LIGHTING
macros.note: 4 GLSL sites (#if value form); NO injector found -> always 0. Confirm/remove (do NOT remove in this slice).

macros.name: ENABLE_TEXTURE1
macros.note: 4 GLSL sites in gos_vertex*.frag; NO injector; legacy fixed-function multitexture path.

macros.name: MC2_STATIC_PROP_LIGHTING
macros.note: 2 GLSL sites in lighting.hglsl; NO injector (only a comment mention in mech3d.cpp). Branch likely never compiled-in.

macros.name: MC2_PI
macros.note: self-defined #ifndef fallback constant in pbr_common.hglsl; not a variant axis, not injected. Intentional.

non_variant_tokens.version_430: #version 430 injected at every site; constant, carries no variant identity (Vulkan SPIR-V has no #version).

tooling_coverage.reflect_py_SHADER_VARIANTS: static_prop.{frag,vert} (default/coalesce/objectid/both), mech.{frag,vert} (default/objectid/viewuniforms), shadow_static_prop.vert (default/coalesce), gpu_cull.comp (default/c1b/c2_readback), cardcloud_sim.comp; KNOWN_VARIANT_MACROS={MC2_COALESCE,MC2_OBJECT_ID_BUFFER} only.
tooling_coverage.matrix_harness_ANCHORS: MRT_ENABLED, TERRAIN_NORMAL_ARRAY, MC2_SHADOW_CSM, MC2_SHADOW_CSM_MAX (hard-fail if inject or guard disappears; all else WARN-only).

gaps_no_fix: 3 dead/stale macros with no injector: ENABLE_VERTEX_LIGHTING, ENABLE_TEXTURE1, MC2_STATIC_PROP_LIGHTING (confirm + prune in a separate cleanup slice).
MC2_STATICPROP_PBR_SLOTS: injected + GLSL-tested but covered by neither reflect.py nor matrix anchors (reflection gap).
MC2_USE_VIEW_UNIFORMS: reflect.py compiles mech combo only; static_prop combo unreflected.
READBACK_SSBO_BINDING: injected but never a guard (literal substitution) — expected, not stale.
next: PIPELINE-KEY-SCHEMA-1 (variant space is finite; define shaderVariantId over the OFFLINE_VARIANT set + SPECIALIZATION_CONSTANT params).
governance: check-shader-injectors.py asserts every C++-injected shader define has an entry in this inventory (allowlist) so the surface cannot grow ungoverned.
